description: This file declares classes and interfaces related to the MediaPipelineModuleService in the Rialto media server IPC component. It includes class definitions for a factory and the service implementation, with methods for managing media sessions, client connections, and media controls, as well as external dependencies on protobuf and IPC interfaces.

classes.name: MediaPipelineModuleServiceFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of MediaPipelineModuleService, implementing the IMediaPipelineModuleServiceFactory interface.

classes.name: MediaPipelineModuleService
classes.description: Implementation of the IMediaPipelineModuleService interface, managing media sessions and client interactions within the Rialto IPC framework.

methods.name: MediaPipelineModuleServiceFactory::create
methods.description: Creates and returns a shared pointer to a new IMediaPipelineModuleService instance, given a reference to IMediaPipelineService.

methods.name: MediaPipelineModuleService::clientConnected
methods.description: Handles a new client connection, associating the client with media sessions.

methods.name: MediaPipelineModuleService::clientDisconnected
methods.description: Handles client disconnection, cleaning up associated media sessions.

methods.name: MediaPipelineModuleService::createSession
methods.description: Creates a new media session for a client based on the provided request.

methods.name: MediaPipelineModuleService::destroySession
methods.description: Destroys an existing media session identified in the request.

methods.name: MediaPipelineModuleService::load
methods.description: Loads media content as specified in the request.

methods.name: MediaPipelineModuleService::setVideoWindow
methods.description: Sets the video window parameters for media playback.

methods.name: MediaPipelineModuleService::attachSource
methods.description: Attaches a media source to a session.

methods.name: MediaPipelineModuleService::removeSource
methods.description: Removes a media source from a session.

methods.name: MediaPipelineModuleService::allSourcesAttached
methods.description: Checks if all sources are attached for a session.

methods.name: MediaPipelineModuleService::play
methods.description: Starts media playback.

methods.name: MediaPipelineModuleService::pause
methods.description: Pauses media playback.

methods.name: MediaPipelineModuleService::stop
methods.description: Stops media playback.

methods.name: MediaPipelineModuleService::setPosition
methods.description: Sets the playback position.

methods.name: MediaPipelineModuleService::haveData
methods.description: Checks if media data is available.

methods.name: MediaPipelineModuleService::setPlaybackRate
methods.description: Sets the playback rate.

methods.name: MediaPipelineModuleService::getPosition
methods.description: Retrieves the current playback position.

methods.name: MediaPipelineModuleService::renderFrame
methods.description: Renders a video frame.

methods.name: MediaPipelineModuleService::setVolume
methods.description: Sets the media volume.

methods.name: MediaPipelineModuleService::getVolume
methods.description: Retrieves the current media volume.

methods.name: MediaPipelineModuleService::setMute
methods.description: Mutes or unmutes the media.

methods.name: MediaPipelineModuleService::getMute
methods.description: Checks if the media is muted.
